description: This file defines a class 'PluralVariants' that manages form elements for handling plural forms in Drupal's configuration translation module, including generating source and translation form elements for pluralized strings.

classes.name: PluralVariants
classes.description: A class extending FormElementBase that provides form elements for managing plural forms in configuration translation.

methods.name: getSourceElement
methods.description: Generates a form element for the source language, displaying plural forms with labels and markup.

methods.name: getTranslationElement
methods.description: Generates a form element for the translation language, providing input fields for plural forms.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration values for the form element, handling serialization of multiple values.
